title: An explicit periodic signing of C_n(1,2) below the conjectured minimum
summary: The paper's disproof of Suvagiya's signed-circulant minimum conjecture on an infinite arithmetic progression, formalized at the matrix level. For every n divisible by 8, Lean defines the paper's period-8 triangle-flux signing of the circulant graph C_n(1,2) as an explicit signed adjacency matrix, proves it is a plus-minus-one signing of mathlib's circulant graph, and proves by exact rational sum-of-squares window certificates that every eigenvalue has absolute value at most 1397/500.
